In Vimpeli, 136 km by road from Vaasa, the nearest unit by drive time, 15 breast sessions mean 16 nights away versus 6 with 5 [S60, S59].

1. The head of radiotherapy could evaluate a single 8 Gy session as default for uncomplicated painful bone metastases: equal pain relief, more retreatment [S31, S30, S32, S62]. In Vimpeli, expected nights away are 2.4 with a single 8 Gy session versus 6.2 with multiple fractions [S60, S59, S30]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews default eligibility [S31, S30]. This serves "National targets and key effectiveness indicators defined for agreed cancers" [S61].

2. The breast oncology lead could evaluate 5 sessions as default for eligible patients without nodal radiotherapy, non-inferior to 15, with distance a reason to choose it [S9, S11, S15, S14]. Calculated for breast alone, it removes 124 nights away and frees 551 machine sessions yearly [S33, S57, S34, S35, S60]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews eligibility [S15, S14]. This serves "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S25, S24].

3. The director of cancer services could evaluate annual reporting of schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band [S21]. Within 30 days, the director of cancer services and the clinical team decide which figures to report [S21]. This serves "Regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services" [S26].

Distances are road estimates [S59, S57, S60].
